senses.gloss: Jaitra, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 611 (Śalvap.): IX, 26, 1404, 1414 (is slain by Bhīmasena).

*jaitra (“victorious”), said of various chariots: II, 490 (rathaṃ, viz. Hariścandra's), 940 (rathena, viz. Indra's), 2064 (rathavaraḥ, viz. Yudhishṭhira's); III, 16510 (Maghonaḥ-i.e. Indra's--syandanottamaḥ); V, 3645 (rathottamaṃ, viz. Indra's); VII, 2479 (rathaṃ, viz. Arjuna's); VIII, †3526 (do., do.).
